name: exo-mailboxes-with-archive-disabled
title: Exchange Online Mailboxes with Archive Disabled
shortDescription: This script identifies Exchange Online mailboxes without an enabled archive and exports the results to a timestamped CSV report.
longDescription: Connects to Exchange Online using certificate-based application authentication, retrieves mailboxes and their archive status, then reports mailboxes where ArchiveStatus is None. The read-only assessment creates a timestamped CSV report and execution log.
